definitions.explanation: The building where classes are held at a school.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{校舎|こうしゃ}
{古|ふる}い{校舎|こうしゃ}を{建|た}て{替|か}える。
examples.english: To rebuild the old school building.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{校舎|こうしゃ}が{損傷|そんしょう}したため、{生徒|せいと}たちは{仮設|かせつ}{校舎|こうしゃ}で{授業|じゅぎょう}を{受|う}けている。
examples.english: Because the school building was damaged in the earthquake, students are taking classes in a temporary building.

notes:
{校舎|こうしゃ} refers to school buildings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {校舎|こうしゃ}の{中|なか}/外 (inside/outside the school building)
- {新|あたら}しい/古い{校舎|こうしゃ} (new/old school building)
- {仮設|かせつ}{校舎|こうしゃ} (temporary school building)

RELATED:
- {校庭|こうてい} (schoolyard)
- {教室|きょうしつ} (classroom)
- {体育館|たいいくかん} (gymnasium)
